newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK156 mln 42-day T-bills,rate down.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK156 mln 42-day T-bills,rate down.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry raised 156 million kuna through 42-day treasury bills at an auction on Tuesday.
The issue was priced higher at 98.891 percent with the rate of 9.75 percent, down from 10 percent on April 1.
The bills are payable in two days and they mature on May 29, the ministry said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
It had offered 120 million kuna but raised another 36 million due to strong demand.
Over 97 percent of the issue was sold to the banking sector while other investors bought only 2.3 percent.
The ministry set a new auction for April 29, when it will offer to investors 65 million kuna worth of 42-day bills.
Foreigners have no direct access to bill sales but can place their bids through Croatian banks. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
